scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.build:ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run build
scripts.db:list:local: pnpm wrangler d1 migrations list xiaoland-site --local --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:apply:local: pnpm wrangler d1 migrations apply xiaoland-site --local --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:list:preview: pnpm wrangler d1 migrations list xiaoland-site-preview --env preview --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:apply:preview: pnpm wrangler d1 migrations apply xiaoland-site-preview --env preview --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:list: pnpm wrangler d1 migrations list xiaoland-site --env production --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:apply: pnpm wrangler d1 migrations apply xiaoland-site --env production --config wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:worker && pnpm run deploy:pages
